## AI Morning Brief · pipeline status
A fully automated AI news brand: every morning AI collects the news, writes the edition, renders carousels and voiced Shorts, publishes the website, then posts to Instagram, Threads, YouTube and Telegram.

This workflow **only reads** the GitHub Actions runs that do the work and shows the result of every stage. Click **Refresh now** or let it run every 30 minutes.

### ☕ Morning edition (~05:00)
News → Claude writes → English → images & voiced Shorts → website → push notification at 07:00

### 📣 Social posting (~14:00, morning in the US)
Instagram (carousel, 2 voiced Reels, 7 stories) → Threads → YouTube (Shorts series + weekly video) → Telegram

### ▶ Actions
The boxes marked **▶** start one job by hand: hover a box and click its play button (**Execute step**). They are not connected to the flow, so the 30-minute refresh never runs them.
Social posting skips posts that are already online (Telegram may post again).
